title: bzf-epbd: a building's data as the EPBD asks for it
description: A proposal for the data a building's energy performance certificate, renovation passport and digital building logbook exchange under Directive (EU) 2024/1275 (EPBD): every data point of its Annex V (certificate), Annex VIII (renovation passport), Annex I (the calculation's inputs and outputs), Annex III (life-cycle GWP) and Articles 12, 16, 19, 20(8), 22 and 24, plus the identifiers that link a building to the cadastre, the land register and a national building register (Art. 22(7)). Field descriptions name the clause they answer. Figures are per m² of the reference floor area and year unless they say otherwise. Shares are fractions (0 to 1), money is in `currency`, VAT included, and free text (labels, reasons, notes) is in `language`. Keys and listed values are English; a value national to one country carries its code, `<country>:<value>` (`de:isfp`), one the EPBD or an EU or international standard defines stays bare (`nzeb`). Times are RFC 3339 with the local offset (`Z` only for a time kept in UTC). Version 0.1 carries a building's current certificate, passport and assessment, the last issued; earlier ones stay with the registers and logbooks that hold them. Every object keeps fields it doesn't list, so a reader of this version reads a newer minor one (`format`). It can be written from and read into the open building format bzf (https://bauzertifikate.de/schema/bzf/1/); MAPPINGS.md in the specification lists where each data point lies there. Status: proposal, offered to CEN/TC 442/WG 13 and its DIN mirror committee for the logbook's core data template. Licence: CC0 1.0.

format.description: This format and its version, `bzf-epbd/<major>.<minor>`; this schema's is 0.1. A newer minor only adds fields and values, so a reader of 0.1 reads every 0.x file and names what it doesn't know rather than dropping it unsaid. Another major version is another format and isn't read as this one.

written.description: Who wrote the file, when and from which project state, so a register or logbook can tell two files of one building apart and trace one back to where it came from. It describes the file, not the building: a reader keeps it with the file, not in the building's record.

app.description: The software that wrote it: "bauzertifikate Aufmaß".

kernelVersion.description: The version of the calculation kernel that worked out what is derived (the envelope).

project.description: The id of the project it was written from (in bzf, project.json `id`), the same in every file of that project.

revision.description: The project state it was written from: in bzf the revision's SHA-256 (revision.json), so the file is traced to the exact data it shows.

language.description: The language of the file's free text, as a BCP 47 tag: "de", "fr-BE".

currency.description: The currency of every amount of money in the file, ISO 4217: "EUR".

systems.description: The technical building systems (Art. 2(6), Art. 16(1), Annex I 4(b) to (f), (k), 5; Annex V 2(a), (i) to (m), (r), (s)).

consumption.description: Metered energy consumption by carrier and period (Annex V 2(q), Annex I 1, Art. 22(1)).

inspections.description: Inspections of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems over 70 kW (Art. 23, Art. 24(3)).

knownOrNewer.description: One of the values a field lists, or a newer one, kept. National values carry their country, `<country>:<value>`. Only strings: bzf also keeps newer values that are objects, which this version doesn't carry.

when.description: When it was issued: an RFC 3339 time with its offset, or a date (ISO 8601) where only the day is known.

service.description: An energy use as Annex V and Annex I 2 list them.

heatNetwork.description: A connection to a district heating or cooling network, or its potential: `connected`, `available` (a network is there to connect to), `planned`, `none`, `unknown`.

identifier.description: An id in someone else's register: the scheme that issued it and its value. National schemes carry their country: for a building `de:alkis` (the German cadastre), `de:land-register`, `<country>:building-id` (a national building register, once one exists); for a registration the register, `de:dibt`, `de:bafa`.

registration.description: Where something issued was registered or uploaded: the register as `scheme`, the number it got as `value`, and when.

building.description: Who and where the building is. At least one of identifiers, address and location, so a register or logbook can link the record to its building.

identifiers.description: The ids the building has in other registers, so a database links it to the cadastre, the land register and logbooks (Art. 22(7)). The directive names no building identifier.

address.description: Its postal address (national, e.g. § 85 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 GEG/GModG).

location.description: Where it lies, for the outdoor climate, solar exposure and heat planning (Annex I 4(g), Art. 22(3)).

crs.description: A projected coordinate reference system by its EPSG code: "EPSG:25832" (ETRS89 / UTM 32N); across borders EPSG:3035 (ETRS89 / LAEA Europe).

category.description: Its category as Annex I 6 lists them.

n50.description: Air changes at 50 Pa, 1/h, where measured (Annex I 4(e)).

thermalBridges.description: How thermal bridges are accounted for (Annex I 4(a)(v)): `default` (a flat allowance on the envelope's U-values), `reduced` (the details follow a national catalogue of good practice, so a smaller allowance applies), `detailed` (each bridge calculated); with the allowance, where one applies.

deltaU.description: The allowance on the envelope's U-values, W/(m²·K).

seismic.description: Its seismic safety, where relevant (Annex VIII 2(f)).

zone.description: The earthquake zone of the national annex to EN 1998-1.

note.description: What is known of the structure's resistance.

envelope.description: The thermal envelope as worked out from the building's geometry: part of the data needed for the calculation uploaded with a certificate (Art. 20(8), Annex I 4(a), (g), (h)), and Annex V 2(e) to (g).

netFloorArea.description: Net floor area of the heated spaces, inside their walls, m²: the useful floor area of Art. 2(51) as the geometry gives it. The figures' own reference area is `figures.area`.

parts.description: The envelope by element, what lies behind it and the direction it faces, net of openings.

azimuth.description: Compass bearing of the outward normal in degrees clockwise from north (0 north, 90 east), in steps of 45°; absent for a horizontal part.

meanUOpaque.description: Average U-value of the opaque elements, W/(m²·K) (Annex V 2(e)).

meanUTransparent.description: Average U-value of the transparent elements, W/(m²·K) (Annex V 2(f)).

commonWindow.description: Type of the most common transparent element (Annex V 2(g)): "insulatingDouble", "triple".

meanG.description: Average total solar energy transmittance of the windows (Annex I 4(a)(iii), 4(h)).

shadedShare.description: Share of the windows' area with solar protection (Annex I 4(h)).

id.description: Its id where it came from, so data coming back finds it.

type.description: Its type within its kind: a boiler `condensing`, a heat pump `outdoorAir`, a thermal storage `hotWater` or `buffer`, emitters `underfloor`, automation `indoorQualitySensors` (Annex V 2(i)) or `indoorQualityControls` (Annex V 2(j)), a charging point `ac` or `dc`.

carrier.description: The energy carrier it takes in.

output.description: Rated output, kW (Annex V 2(a): size of generator).

peakPower.description: A PV array's peak power, kWp (Annex I 4(c)).

endOfLife.description: Year its lifespan is expected to end (Annex V 2(m), Art. 16(1), Art. 19(9)).

signals.description: Whether it can react to external signals and adjust its consumption.

flowTemperature.description: Design supply temperature of a distribution or emitters, °C.

efficiency.description: Seasonal efficiency of a generator, as a fraction (Art. 16(1)).

scop.description: A heat pump's seasonal coefficient of performance, or its seasonal performance factor as measured.

seer.description: A cooling unit's seasonal energy efficiency ratio (Annex I 4(d), Art. 16(1)).

power.description: Rated electrical input power, kW: built-in lighting (Annex I 4(f)), fans, pumps.

airflow.description: A ventilation unit's design air volume flow, m³/h (Annex I 4(e)).

specificFanPower.description: A ventilation unit's specific fan power, W/(m³/h).

insulation.description: How a distribution's pipes or a thermal storage are insulated (Annex I 4(b)).

standingLoss.description: A thermal storage's standing heat loss, kWh a day.

heatRecovery.description: A ventilation unit's heat recovery efficiency (Annex I 4(e)).

automationClass.description: Building automation and control class of EN ISO 52120-1 (Annex I 4(k)).

factors.description: Primary energy and emission factors of what it takes in, where they are its own: a district heating network's (Annex V 2(s)).

count.description: How many alike it stands for: recharging points (Annex V 2(k)).

energy.description: A battery's usable capacity, kWh: an amount of energy, not a volume (Annex V 2(l)).

volume.description: A thermal storage's volume, litres, not m³ (Annex V 2(l)).

metered.description: Metered consumption of one carrier over one period.

services.description: The energy uses the meter covers.

figures.description: The figures of a certificate, a renovation step or a target, as the issuing method calculated or measured them (the certificate's `basis` and `method`).

class.description: Energy performance class (Annex V 1(a); Annex VIII 1(e)(v) per step), on `classScale`.

classScale.description: The scale `class` and `emissionClass` are on: `eu` for the harmonised A to G of Art. 19(2), or a national one, `de:geg` (A+ to H).

primaryEnergy.description: Annual primary energy use, kWh/(m²·a) (Annex V 1(b)): the non-renewable part where the method separates it, else the total. A writer that has both also fills `primaryEnergyTotal`.

finalEnergy.description: Annual final energy use, kWh/(m²·a) (Annex V 1(c)).

energyNeed.description: Calculated energy needs, kWh/(m²·a) (Annex V 1, second paragraph (c)).

emissions.description: Operational greenhouse gas emissions, kg CO₂-eq/(m²·a) (Annex V 1(e)).

emissionClass.description: Greenhouse gas emission class (Annex V 2(b)), on `classScale`.

renewableShare.description: Renewable energy produced on site as a fraction of the building's final energy use (Annex V 1(d); Annex VIII 1(g) after renovation); above 1 where it produces more than it uses.

renewableProduction.description: Renewable energy produced on site, kWh a year (Annex V 1, second paragraph (b)); its carrier and source follow from the producing systems.

selfConsumption.description: Share of the renewable energy produced on site the building uses itself (Annex VIII 1(g)).

lifeCycleGwp.description: Life-cycle global warming potential, kg CO₂-eq/m² of useful floor area over 50 years (Annex V 1(e), Art. 7(2)).

lifeCycleGwpStages.description: The same per EN 15978 module (Annex III): "A1-A3", "A4-A5", "B1-B7", "C1-C4", "D".

carbonRemovals.description: Carbon removals by temporary storage in or on the building, kg CO₂-eq/m² (Annex V 2(c)).

uses.description: The figures per energy use: `heating`, `cooling`, `hotWater`, `ventilation`, `lighting` (Annex V 2(a), Annex I 2).

energyCosts.description: Energy costs a year at the stated prices, in `currency` (Annex VIII 1(e)(iv)).

standard.description: A standard reached (Annex VIII 2(b)(ii)): `nzeb`, `zeb`, or a national one, `de:effizienzhaus-70`.

area.description: The reference floor area the figures are per, m² (Art. 2(52)); with it the annual totals in kWh (Annex V 1, second paragraph (a)).

areaKindNational.description: The area's national definition: `de:AN` (GEG Gebäudenutzfläche), `de:NGF` (DIN 277 net floor area), `de:WoFlV` (living area).

references.description: The reference values stated beside the figures, kWh/(m²·a) of primary energy, as they apply to this building (Art. 19(1), Annex VIII 2(b)(ii)).

issue.description: Something issued: when, until when, where registered.

validUntil.description: The last day it is valid, inclusive.

inspection.description: An inspection report (Art. 23, 24): what was inspected and what came of it.

contact.description: A one-stop shop for renovation advice (Annex V 1(f), Annex VIII 1(j)).

certificate.description: The energy performance certificate issued last (Art. 19, Annex V); `validUntil` at most ten years on (Art. 19(13)), `registrations` its numbers in registers and databases (Art. 20(8)).

basis.description: How its figures were obtained (Annex I 1): `calculated` by an energy balance under standard conditions, or `measured` from metered consumption.

method.description: The method and edition the figures come from: "DIN/TS 18599:2025-10", "EN ISO 52000-1:2017".

reactsToSignals.description: Whether the building can react to external signals and adjust its energy consumption (Annex V 1, second paragraph (d)).

lowTemperatureHeating.description: Whether the heat distribution can work at low or more efficient temperatures (Annex V 1, second paragraph (e); Annex V 2(n); Art. 19(8)).

lowTemperatureHotWater.description: Whether the domestic hot water can work at more efficient temperatures (Annex V 2(o)).

lowTemperatureCooling.description: Whether the air-conditioning can work at more efficient temperatures (Annex V 2(p)).

overheatingRisk.description: The overheating risk analysis (Annex V 2(h)): its result, `low`, `high` or the method's own, and the method.

passportAvailable.description: Whether a renovation passport is available (Annex V 2(d)).

recommendations.description: Recommendations for cost-effective improvement (Art. 19(5) to (7)), each with the figures it would give.

heatNetwork.description: As the certificate states it (Annex V 2(r)).

passport.description: The renovation passport issued last (Art. 12, Annex VIII), or the roadmap before it is issued.

issued.description: Absent while the roadmap is not issued.

visit.description: The on-site visit it rests on (Art. 12(4)).

target.description: What the roadmap aims at, renewable share and self-consumption included (Annex VIII 1(g)).

heatNetwork.description: Potential connection to an efficient district heating or cooling system (Annex VIII 1(f)).

perKWh.description: Price per kWh of final energy.

perYear.description: Fixed price a year (a standing charge).

increase.description: Price increase a year, as a fraction.

steps.description: The steps of the staged renovation in their order, past renovations first (Annex VIII 1(b), 2(e)).

step.description: A step of a renovation roadmap, or a certificate's recommendation.

until.description: Last year of the range planned.

trigger.description: The occasion it waits for instead of a year.

duration.description: Time it takes to carry out, weeks of seven days (Annex VIII 2(b)(v)).

status.description: `planned`, `done` (a past renovation, Annex VIII 2(e)) or `declined` by the owner. Absent: planned.

rationale.description: Why it comes in this place (Annex VIII 1(d)).

requirements.description: Technical, safety and low-temperature conditions (Annex VIII 2(c)(iii), (v)).

lifetime.description: Expected service life, whole years (Annex VIII 2(b)(vii)).

costs.description: Estimated costs in `currency` (Annex VIII 2(b)(iii), (vii)); commercial, given only where its holder shares them.

anywayCosts.description: The part of the investment that would be due anyway, as repair or replacement, without the renovation.

maintenanceYearly.description: What keeping it in order costs a year once done (Annex VIII 2(b)(vii)).

figures.description: The building's figures after the step (Annex VIII 1(e)(ii) to (v); Art. 19(7)).

smartReadiness.description: The smart readiness assessment issued last (Art. 15, Annex V 2, last paragraph).

value.description: The indicator as a fraction, its percentage divided by 100.
